role: tag set disjoint from the domain of a structure
notes: The set of members u of the union of the union of the domain with u not a member of u; it is not in that union, so pairs tagged with it are new elements. Local construction device.

role: cardinal bounding the new elements of the one-step extension
notes: max of |L|, |dom M|, |P_M| and aleph_0. Local to the one-step lemma and the construction.

role: set of all realization tasks over subsets of a structure
notes: Pairs (A,p), in the annex triples (A,n,p), with A a subset of dom M and p a complete type over A in finitely many variables consistent with M. Not a type space and not the power-set operation.

role: set containing the domain of every one-step candidate extension
notes: dom M united with mu_M times {s_M}. Used only in the annex.

role: set of one-step extensions of a structure
notes: The nonempty set given by the one-step lemma; the successor stage of the construction is chosen from it. Used only in the annex.

role: set of admissible construction sequences of length beta+1
notes: Defined by recursion without choices; distinct from the P11 predicate \(\mathsf{Seq}_{\mathcal A}\) (different font, role and scope). Used only in the annex.

role: stage alpha of the saturating elementary chain
notes: N_0 = M, successor stages from the one-step lemma, unions at limits, alpha at most kappa^+.
